name: Francisco Assis - § 21 - Am 4
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 21. Firmly rejects the proposal to grant the EU a permanent seat in all multilateral forums, which would limit the ability of Member States to act in their national interests and weaken their national sovereignty; stresses that conferring state-like attributes to the EU constitutes a direct threat to the sovereignty of Member States and represents a further step towards federalisation; recalls that, in accordance with Article 24(1) TEU and the relevant Declarations of the 2007 Intergovernmental Conference, the provisions of the Common Foreign and Security Policy (CFSP) do not allow the EU to encroach on the competencies of Member States, including in conducting their foreign policy, managing their national diplomatic services, maintaining relations with non-EU countries, or participating in international organiations, including the United Nations Security Council;
